sources.entry: LibreTime - Broadcast streaming radio on the web (fork of Airtime). (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/PHP

summary.one_liner: LibreTime is a community-managed fork of Airtime for running an online or terrestrial radio station.
summary.what_it_does: LibreTime is radio station management software for running an online or terrestrial radio station. It is described as a community-managed fork of the Airtime project. The README covers the project's community, support channels, and development process but does not list specific features such as scheduling, playout, or streaming details. Documentation is referred to externally. Support is offered through a community forum and a Matrix chat room, and the GitHub issue tracker is reserved for confirmed bugs and well-formed feature requests. The project is released under a Contributor Code of Conduct.
notable: Community-managed fork of the Airtime radio software project
Support via community forum and Matrix chat
Governed by a contributor community of radio stations
caveats: README does not include installation or run instructions; refer to external documentation
README does not describe specific features in detail
Support is community-based rather than guaranteed
